name: jyut-ocr-proofread
description: Transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs and OCR Markdown with Cantonese jyut-ocr conventions, book-specific notation policies, long-book segmentation, missing-page recovery, page-boundary checks, source/render provenance, and deterministic release audits.

interface.shortDescription: Transcribe and audit historical Chinese PDF OCR.
interface.longDescription: Use a Cantonese jyut-ocr workflow to transcribe and proofread historical Chinese PDFs: preserve printed glyph variants, editorial notation and old punctuation; isolate long-book page ranges safely; detect duplicate or missing scans; reconstruct cross-page text, footnotes, headings, lists and tables; and verify source exceptions plus assembly freshness before delivery.
defaultPrompt: 校對一份 jyut-ocr Markdown，逐頁對同名 PDF。
識別一份長篇歷史中文 PDF，分段校對後安全合併。
檢查 PDF 重複掃描、缺失印刷頁同跨頁註腳。
清理 OCR 頁面家具同低信心括號。
逐頁檢查歷史中文 OCR 轉寫。
